question: Can fixed Qwen3 4B infer human exit-choice probabilities from training-only human condition summaries, with added value over newly fitted clean-source statistical baselines?
selection: All knowledge=0 records, and knowledge=3 records with unequal crowd counts; source-gate selection only. The same filter applies to training and scoring.
validation: Leave out both count-mirrored conditions of each (min(left,right),max(left,right),knowledge) family. Self-mirror balanced no-map family also held out in full. No participant-row split.
human_data_presentation: All other families as per-condition assigned crowd counts, map code 0/3, observed human left/right counts. No held-family labels, demographic data, timing or previous model scores. Aggregation preserves sufficient statistics for the fixed baselines.
training_weights: Condition equal weights, participant equal weights within each condition.
frequency_smoothing: Same historical formula: (condition-weighted mean times training n + 0.5)/(training n+1).
rule_smoothing: Same historical condition-weighted agreement formula, Laplace(1,1); ties return 0.5.
invalid_policy: One attempt per frozen task; preserve raw failure and stop after three consecutive errors. No fallbacks, repair calls, prompt tuning, model replacement or response selection. Only score a complete valid set.
decision: Gate pass authorizes proposing independent confirmation only. Gate failure closes this fixed human-context configuration, without another prompt search on the same data. Partial/invalid runtime is inconclusive, not predictive failure.
learning_disclosure: The human-context LLM and fitted baselines share the same training outcomes and scene variables, but have different learning procedures, inductive biases and computation. The scene-only LLM is an ablation without labels. Context learning is not model-weight fine-tuning.
development_visibility: All 246 human outcomes and prior scores have been examined. New grouped predictions reduce held-family leakage but cannot turn this dataset into unseen confirmation. Only 9 fixed families; training folds overlap. Descriptive sensitivity, no population significance claim.
scope: Static exit choice in a virtual task. Does not establish dynamic guidance response, real fire behavior or evacuation-control efficacy.
